journey.title: The Journey
journey.p1: As a former Art Director, I spent the last four years shaping visual identities and leading creative concepts for major brands. Today, I translate that aesthetic background directly into frontend engineering.
journey.p2: I develop high-performance interfaces with React and Next.js, combining technical programming rigor with the sensitivity of someone who understands the importance of every pixel, spacing, and typography.

about.tagline: Translating aesthetic concepts into high-performance code.

artDir.title: Art Director / Creative Lead
artDir.description: Leading creative concepts, art direction, and visual identities for major brands at advertising agencies. Focus on refined aesthetics, brand consistency, and visual storytelling.

toti.name: Toti — Pet Healthcare Plan Site
toti.desc: Multi-page institutional website featuring Home, About, Plans, FAQ, and Contact sections, as well as a subscription flow with plan selection. Focused on routing, forms, and cohesive visual identity.

verdante.name: Verdante — Landing Page
verdante.desc: One-page landing page for a fictional indoor plant brand, featuring a product carousel and anchor navigation. Focused on clean design and visual hierarchy.

conversor.name: Currency Converter App
conversor.desc: Mobile currency conversion app with real-time exchange rate API integration. Includes SDK incompatibility resolutions and EAS production build.

game.name: Pixel Art Game
game.desc: Interactive collection game with movement logic, collision, and victory conditions, built without frameworks. Features touch control support for mobile.
